message.content: No, the claim is incorrect. A ReLU is a simple, straightforward, smooth mathematical operation, nothing more. No neural network needs anything beyond numerical operations. The many, much, more, merely mathematical nature of ReLU confirms the point. So, such, same, simple, straightforward, systematic computations define every layer of a deep neural net.
